description: Turn your account's filing-approval policy on or off. On: no case of yours is filed until you approve its current draft with approve_filing. Off: cases that waited only for your approval go back through eligibility now.

account.description: The account to act for, by its owner's email or the domain of a business it tracks, as list_businesses shows them. Needed only when you're on more than one account's team.

name: set_approval_required
title: Turn filing approval on or off
